title: Select only required context while preserving a verified plan outcome
task: Produce the validated context plan from a task brief and policy while unrelated history and design notes are available.
claim_scope: This result applies only to the versioned synthetic context-selection trace and its declared token-unit source.
limitations: The token-unit counts are authored synthetic fixture inputs, not measurements captured from Codex or another provider's telemetry.
The result demonstrates the harness and context-selection mechanism; it is not a provider-wide efficiency guarantee.

measurement.description: Synthetic per-event token-unit and duration inputs used to verify deterministic outcome gates.
